calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_to) AS max_to, max(join_date) AS max_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, tier, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_cur FROM dim_member WHERE is_current),
cur2 AS (SELECT member_id, tier, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_open FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04'-364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur WHERE tier='Gold') AS gold_current,
 (SELECT max(n_cur) FROM cur) AS max_current_versions,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur2 WHERE tier='Gold') AS gold_valid_on_4oct,
 (SELECT max(n_open) FROM cur2) AS max_open_versions,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.member_id) FROM cur c JOIN act a USING (member_id) WHERE c.tier='Gold') AS gold_active_52w,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current AND join_date>DATE '2026-10-04') AS gold_future_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>DATE '9999-12-31') AS bad_current,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members
